Name: Clean and Block for Barns and Coops
Author: pepoluan
Description:
This mod is [i]inspired[/i] by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/926]"Cleaner Barns & Coops"[/url] mod, but created from scratch by me.

Main difference from the aforementioned inspirational mod: [b]This mod uses [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher (version 1.8 or newer)[/b][/url] to do its trick; no more replacing XNB files.
[b]
[/b][b]See Changelog for new things in each released version.[/b]

[b][u][size=4]Installation:[/size][/u]

[/b][list=1]
[*](Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher (version 1.8 or newer)[/url]﻿ has been installed and working)
[*]Extract the downloaded .7z file into the Mods directory
[*]Done!
[/list]
(This mod does NOT have anything configurable, so no [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] to edit.)

Downloads.Description: v0.9 uses CP 1.8's new "EditMap" action. This should allow cooperation with mods that want to edit the Barn* and Coop* map files. Also, expanded the NPC Blocker area in front of entrance nook for Barns.
